name: set_status_light
description:
Set the color of the physical desk status light.

    Use this tool when the user wants to change their availability indicator,
    "set my light to red", "I'm in a meeting" (blue), "I'm free now" (green),
    "do not disturb" (red).

    Args:
        color: red, green, or blue

color.description: Color to display on the status light: 'red' (busy/do-not-disturb), 'green' (available), or 'blue' (focus/meeting).
color.title: Color
